$comment: Hand-written input for scripts/credits/generate.mjs (run `pnpm credits` after editing). Packages are read from package.json files and node_modules; this file only holds what cannot be: which workspace packages ship, licenses allowed at runtime, notes, programs we run, code adapted from other projects, and inspiration.

alsoShipped.tailwindcss: A build tool, but the CSS it generates (including its preflight reset) is part of the web UI.

notes.@parcel/watcher: Also installs a prebuilt native binary for your platform (@parcel/watcher-<platform>, MIT).

programs.name: Git
programs.description: The daemon runs your installed git as a separate program for every read. octopus-diff does not bundle or link it.

adapted.name: T3 Code

files.what: The path rules of the command-palette browse mode.

adapted.design: The sidebar (folders, the Settled shelf, settling by hand), the folder picker and the command palette's browse mode are modelled on T3 Code's UI.
